title: Moon Bricks
description: A paddle, a ball, a satisfying bounce.
intro: Left already works! Try it, then look at its rule in update(). Can you write a matching rule for Right? Replace pass with your idea, run it, and try your paddle.
ideas: Help me aim the ball by changing where it hits the paddle.
Show me how to make the paddle wider.
Suggest two small variations for my brick breaker and let me choose.
guide: How quickly you move your paddle.
Your rule for bouncing off the paddle.
Your rule when the ball hits a brick.
complete: # A paddle, a ball, and a wall of moon bricks.
# Bounce back up when you hit the paddle.
# What should a broken brick be worth?
museumIntro: Move the paddle with the arrow keys and keep the ball bouncing until every brick disappears. Where the ball meets the paddle changes its direction. Try a wider paddle for an easier game or a faster ball for a challenge.

museumStory.title: One ball. A whole wall of possibilities.
museumStory.text: A ball travels in a straight line—until something gets in its way. A wall sends it back. A brick disappears. Your paddle turns a near miss into another chance. That tiny loop of aim, bounce and try again is the heart of a brick breaker.
museumStory.prompt: What if the paddle were twice as wide? Would every bounce become easier to aim?
